ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: We call a rectangle whose width to length ratio is the golden ratio $\left(\frac{\sqrt{5}-1}{2}\right)$ a golden rectangle. As shown in the figure, in the golden rectangle $ABCD$, where $AB<BC$, $BC=2$, and the bisector of $\angle ABC$ intersects side $AD$ at point $E$, what is the length of $DE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given a golden rectangle $ABCD$, \\
the ratio of width to length is the golden ratio $\left(\frac{\sqrt{5}-1}{2}\right)$, and since AD$\parallel$BC, AD=BC=2, \\
thus, AB=$\left(\frac{\sqrt{5}-1}{2}\right)$BC=$\frac{\sqrt{5}-1}{2}\times 2=\sqrt{5}-1$, \\
because BE is the bisector of $\angle ABC$, \\
it follows that $\angle$ABE=$\angle$CBE, \\
and since AD$\parallel$BC, \\
it also follows that $\angle$AEB=$\angle$CBE=$\angle$ABE, \\
hence, AE=AB=$\sqrt{5}-1$, \\
therefore, DE=AD−AE=2−($\sqrt{5}-1$)=$\boxed{3-\sqrt{5}}$．

As shown in the figure, in the golden rectangle $ABCD$, where $AB<BC$, $BC=2$, and the bisector of $\angle ABC$ intersects side $AD$ at point $E$, what is the length of $DE$?

ready3_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a horizontally placed rectangle ABCD, A is at the upper left corner, B is at the lower left corner, C is at the lower right corner, D is at the upper right corner; point E is located on the upper side AD; line segment BE connects from B to E on the upper side. It can be seen from the figure that AD and BC are parallel, AB and CD are vertical sides, and AD and BC are horizontal sides. Reasoning: Rectangle ABCD is a golden rectangle, and AB<BC, BC=2, so the ratio of the short side AB to the long side BC is (sqrt(5)-1)/2. Therefore AB = ((sqrt(5)-1)/2) * 2 = sqrt(5)-1. Opposite sides of a rectangle are equal, so AD=BC=2. Because BE is the angle bisector of angle ABC, angle ABE = angle CBE. Also because AD parallel BC, and E is on AD, angle AEB = angle CBE. Therefore angle ABE = angle AEB, triangle ABE is an isosceles triangle, obtaining AE=AB=sqrt(5)-1. Thus DE = AD - AE = 2 - (sqrt(5)-1) = 3 - sqrt(5).
